Predicates:
PerformsInTalentShow(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
AttendsEvents(x) ::: x attends school events.
Engaged(x) ::: x is very engaged with school events.
PerformsInTalentShow(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
InactiveMember(x) ::: x is inactive and disinterested member of community.
ChaperonesDances(x) ::: x chaperones high school dances.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
AttendsSchool(x) ::: x attends the school.
WishesFurther(x) ::: x wishes to further academic careers and educational opportunities.
YoungChildOrTeen(x) ::: x is a young child or teenager.

Premises:
∀x (PerformsInTalentShow(x) → AttendsEvents(x) ∧ Engaged(x)) ::: If people perform in school talent shows often, then they attend and are very engaged with school events.
∀x (PerformsInTalentShow(x) ∨ InactiveMember(x)) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive and disinterested members of their community.
∀x (ChaperonesDances(x) → ¬AttendsSchool(x)) ::: If people chaperone high school dances, then they are not students who attend the school.
∀x (InactiveMember(x) → ChaperonesDances(x)) ::: All inactive and disinterested members of community chaperone high school dances.
∀x (YoungChildOrTeen(x) ∧ WishesFurther(x) → (Student(x) ∧ AttendsSchool(x))) ::: All young children and teenagers who wish to further their academic careers are students who attend the school.
BonnieAttendsAndEngaged ∧ BonnieStudent ::: (Bonnie both attends and is very engaged with school events and is a student who attends the school) ∧ (she neither attends and is very engaged nor is a student who attends the school).

Conclusion:
(ChaperonesDances(Bonnie) ∨ ¬ChaperonesDances(Bonnie)) → ((YoungChildOrTeen(Bonnie) ∧ WishesFurther(Bonnie) ∧ InactiveMember(Bonnie))) ::: If Bonnie either chaperones high school dances or, if she does not, she performs in school talent shows often, then she is both a young child or teenager who wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities and an inactive and disinterested member of the community.
